description: Accuracy review for identity, authentication and authorization content on artagon-site (OAuth, OIDC, GNAP, JWT, DPoP, mTLS, WebAuthn and passkeys, verifiable credentials, SD-JWT, Zanzibar and ReBAC). Use when writing or reviewing any page, post, sample or copy that states a protocol fact, cites a standard, or describes how Artagon makes an authorization decision. Read-only review that reports findings.

results.query: can you sanity check the standards claims on src/content/pages/standards.mdx before launch
I wrote 'Artagon is fully OAuth 2.1 compliant (RFC)' in the hero, is that accurate?
review this paragraph: 'GNAP replaces OAuth entirely and every major IdP supports it today'
check the FAQ answers about passkeys and WebAuthn for anything wrong or overstated
implement a JWT verification helper in src/lib for the demo
our use-cases page says we're FAPI 2.0 certified — verify that wording before we ship
make the standards chips on /standards wrap better on mobile
write a fun tagline for the bridge page
add the OAuth 2.1 logo to public/assets/icons
the link to the DPoP RFC on /standards 404s, fix the URL
